instruction: I'd like to create a desktop shortcut for this webpage using Chrome's create shortcut feature so I can access it quickly later.

metadata.explanation: This variation maintains the same task structure (creating a Chrome desktop shortcut) but uses a different website (Wikipedia instead of 2048 game). The evaluator checks for the shortcut name 'Wikipedia' on the desktop, which is more reliable than checking app-id since Chrome generates app-ids dynamically. Uses existing getters and metrics: get_shortcuts_on_desktop and is_shortcut_on_desktop.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator uses name-based verification ('Wikipedia') which is semantically correct and reliable for Chrome desktop shortcuts
Getter (get_shortcuts_on_desktop) correctly retrieves all .desktop files from the desktop directory and reads their contents
Metric (is_shortcut_on_desktop) correctly checks if 'Name=Wikipedia\n' exists in any shortcut content, matching Chrome's .desktop file format on Linux
Expected value 'Wikipedia' matches the actual page title of https://www.wikipedia.org/, so verification will succeed when shortcut is correctly created
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the desktop shortcut creation requirement from the instruction
No postconfig needed: desktop shortcuts persist after creation and can be verified immediately
